rules: Use logical inline/block properties; never encode left/right as meaning.
DOM and focus order remain logical in RTL; visual reordering must not reverse semantics.
Content priority is preserved when columns collapse.
Tables expose a card/list alternative or bounded horizontal scroll with sticky row context.
Touch controls remain at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.

accessibility.conformance: WCAG 2.2 Level AA target; conformance is verified on implemented screens in later steps
requirements: Keyboard access for all interactive controls.
Logical focus order and focus not obscured.
Persian page language and RTL direction are programmatically set.
Status, validation and lifecycle meaning is not color-only.
Form errors have a summary and field-level association.
Async mutation and provider outcomes use appropriate live-region announcements.
Reduced-motion disables non-essential transitions and preserves understanding.
Zoom/reflow to 400 percent does not lose content or operation.
Text spacing overrides do not clip or overlap content.
Authentication does not depend on a cognitive-function test without an alternative.

numerals.machineIdentifiers: Latin when exact copy/paste is required
